passMeaning: The F0.2b.9 audit dossier and its detection controls pass; all three assets remain quarantined and the bank, content certification, Practice, Exam and security remain blocked.

rows.scope: Dossier completeness, candidate-source triage and conservative publication decision for exactly 3/3 Summary Completion assets.
rows.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined; the ledger contains two official policy/sample sources and 14 factual candidates, while the directed provenance search found no useful exact match and does not prove originality.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, license or rights basis, source-to-draft history, factual sign-off and independent human approval remain unresolved.

rows.scope: Exact 3/18/18/19/19 inventory, object and passage identity, word-limit contract, accepted variants, evidence offsets, render closure and next-unit boundary.
rows.findings: The gate reconciles catalog, baseline and registry; 18 canonical answers are whole-token passage spans in intended order and the single extra accepted entry is tracked separately.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: The runtime hard-codes two words without scoring enforcement, exposes keys and hints to the client, lacks versioned persistence, and the accepted alternative `the roof` creates an invalid doubled determiner.

rows.scope: Independent prompt-only, passage-based first pass and source-informed second pass over all 18 questions and 15 factual claims.
rows.findings: The expert preserved 18/18 answer decisions, verified the visible two-word limit and intended passage order, and classified all three sets as mixed rather than certifying them as authentic continuous Summary Completion tasks.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Ten material ambiguities, three minor ambiguities, isolated sentence cards instead of a continuous summary, the `the roof` grammar failure and incomplete factual support block content certification.

rows.scope: Prospective average-student walkthrough from the key-free blind packet for 3 passages and 18 questions.
rows.findings: The walkthrough covers locating evidence, testing grammar and scope, comparing alternatives, respecting the word limit and repairing errors without assigning answers.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This is an AI simulation, not observed student usability, retention, transfer or band improvement evidence.

rows.scope: Detection of position, length, grammatical-class, prompt overlap, hint exposure, client payload leakage and answer-assignment leakage.
rows.findings: The position-modal answer-length shortcut hits 13/18; paragraph-by-position hits 17/18, nominal-phrase classification covers 18/18, and all 18 hints are available before response.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: n=18 cannot certify fairness; strong structural predictability, serialized keys/hints/explanations and guided-training feedback keep Practice, Exam and security blocked.

rows.scope: Not applicable to unchanged learner-runtime conformance in this audit-only delta.
rows.findings: Seven direct learner-facing files and the exact 16-file render closure remain pinned and unchanged by F0.2b.9.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Inherited defects remain: repeated accessible names, missing progress and live semantics, missing English language boundaries, incomplete focus management, destructive reset and no split Text/Questions workflow.

rows.scope: Not applicable to unchanged learner-runtime behavior; portable Chromium later verifies the report only.
rows.findings: No data, copy, DOM, CSS, interaction or route behavior was changed by this unit, so browser conformance is neither newly exercised nor claimed.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Learner-route hydration, accessibility, responsive behavior, focus, reload/reset, word-limit scoring and pre-response payload secrecy remain open for the implementation phase.
